ObjectStates.Name: Bag
ObjectStates.Nickname: SET_ITS18 Last Launch — NeoTerran Command — REVISED
ObjectStates.Description:
Last Launch / NeoTerran Command
48 × 48 inches; 300 points.
Terrain fitted to objective footprints and walking routes.
Room is an 8-inch square Launching Tower with four Wide Gates, infinite-height walls, and no deployment inside. Verify gate access and scanner approaches in TTS.
Official mission: https://experience.corvusbelli.com/en/game-content/91f63013-7db3-4dc9-b2ee-bc2e93a1de14
Geometry revision: TTS engine and visual review still required.

Deployment: take this bag into the normal Infinity mod and drop it onto its map deployment spot.

adList = {
    "https://i.imgur.com/rZViDWc.jpeg",
    "https://i.imgur.com/YBHwWAk.jpeg",
    "https://i.imgur.com/VNwkPVF.jpeg",
	"https://i.imgur.com/Yi1AcWX.jpeg",
    "https://i.imgur.com/sM4PQBs.jpeg",
    "https://i.imgur.com/1MQ74Yi.jpeg",
}

adconfig = {
    P1_COLOR = "Green",
    P2_COLOR = "Red",
    ADTIME = {6,10},
    SCORETIME = {6,14},
    MODE = "both",
    INITIALDISPLAY = "random",
}

local anim = 0;
local current = 0;

adconfig = {
    ADTIME = {6,10},
    INITIALDISPLAY = "random",
}

local anim = 0;
local current = 0;

function randomAd()
    if (#adList > 0) then
        math.randomseed(os.time() + self.guid:byte())
        current = math.random(1, #adList)
        for i,v in ipairs(adList) do
            if (i ~= current) then
                self.UI.hide("ad_"..i)
            end
        end
        self.UI.show("ad_"..current)
        anim = Wait.time(randomAd, math.random(adconfig.ADTIME[1], adconfig.ADTIME[2]) + math.random())
    end
end

function sequenceAd()
    if (#adList > 0) then
        math.randomseed(os.time() + self.guid:byte())
        current = current + 1
        if (current > #adList) then
            current = 1
        end
        for i,v in ipairs(adList) do
            if (i ~= current) then
                self.UI.hide("ad_"..i)
            end
        end
        self.UI.show("ad_"..current)
        anim = Wait.time(sequenceAd, math.random(adconfig.ADTIME[1], adconfig.ADTIME[2]) + math.random())
    end
end

function displayRandom()
    Wait.stop(anim)
    math.randomseed(os.time() + self.guid:byte())
    current = math.random(1, #adList)
    for i,v in ipairs(adList) do
        if (current ~= i) then
            self.UI.hide("ad_"..i)
        end
    end
    self.UI.show("ad_"..current)
    anim = Wait.time(randomAd, math.random(adconfig.ADTIME[1], adconfig.ADTIME[2]) + math.random())
end

function displaySequence()
    Wait.stop(anim)
    current = 1
    for i,v in ipairs(adList) do
        if (i ~= current) then
            self.UI.hide("ad_"..i)
        end
    end
    self.UI.show("ad_"..current)
    anim = Wait.time(sequenceAd, math.random(adconfig.ADTIME[1], adconfig.ADTIME[2]) + math.random())
end

function rebuildUI()

    local scoreChildren = {}

    table.insert(scoreChildren, {
            tag="Panel", attributes={
                width=3600/3.5,
                height=6400/3.5,
                position="0 100 1100",
                rotation="260 0 0",
                color="#000000c0"
            }, children = {
                {
                    tag="Text",
                    attributes={
                        color=adconfig.P1_COLOR,
                        id="score_player1_name",
                        text="",
                        resizeTextMinSize="60",
                        resizeTextMaxSize="140",
                        position="0 700 0",
                        alignment="TopCenter",
                        resizeTextForBestFit=true,
                        width="800",
                        height="200",
                        outline="black",
                        outlineSize="-5 -5",

                    }
                },
                {
                    tag="Text",
                    attributes={
                        color=adconfig.P2_COLOR,
                        id="score_player2_name",
                        text="",
                        resizeTextMinSize="60",
                        resizeTextMaxSize="140",
                        position="0 -100 0",
                        alignment="TopCenter",
                        resizeTextForBestFit=true,
                        width="800",
                        height="200",
                        outline="black",
                        outlineSize="-5 -5",

                    }
                },
                {
                    tag="Text",
                    attributes={
                        color=adconfig.P1_COLOR,
                        id="score_player1_value",
                        text="-",
                        resizeTextMinSize="100",
                        resizeTextMaxSize="400",
                        position="0 400 0",
                        alignment="TopCenter",
                        resizeTextForBestFit=true,
                        width="800",
                        height="800",
                        outline="black",
                        outlineSize="-5 -5",

                    }
                },
                {
                    tag="Text",
                    attributes={
                        color=adconfig.P2_COLOR,
                        id="score_player2_value",
                        text="-",
                        resizeTextMinSize="100",
                        resizeTextMaxSize="400",
                        position="0 -400 0",
                        alignment="TopCenter",
                        resizeTextForBestFit=true,
                        width="800",
                        height="800",
                        outline="black",
                        outlineSize="-5 -5",

                    }
                }
            }
    })

    local ui = {
        {
            tag="Panel",
            attributes={
                position="0 0 0",
                id="score",
                active=false,
                showAnimation="Grow",
                hideAnimation="Shrink",
                animationDuration=1.0
            },
            children = scoreChildren
        }
    }

    local assets = {}
    local assetRefs = {}
    local refLen = 0
    for i,url in pairs(adList) do
        if (assetRefs[url] == nil) then
            refLen = refLen + 1
            assetRefs[url] = self.guid.."_ad_"..refLen
            table.insert(assets, {name=assetRefs[url], url=url})
        end

        table.insert(ui, {
            tag="Panel", children={
                {
                    tag="Image",
                    attributes={
                        color="#ffffffc0",
                        image=(assetRefs[url]),
                        width=3600/3.5,
                        height=6400/3.5,
                        position="0 100 1100",
                        rotation="260 0 0",
                    }
                }
            }, attributes={
                position="0 0 0",
                id=("ad_"..i),
                active=false,
                showAnimation="Grow",
                hideAnimation="Shrink",
                animationDuration=1.0
            }
        })
    end
    self.UI.setCustomAssets(assets)
    self.UI.setXmlTable({ {tag="Panel", children=ui} })
end

function refresh()
    TRH = Global.getTable("TRH") or {}
    self.UI.setAttribute("score_player1_name", "text", TRH['score_p1n'] or "")
    self.UI.setAttribute("score_player1_value", "text", TRH['score_p1v'] or "-")
    self.UI.setAttribute("score_player2_name", "text", TRH['score_p2n'] or "")
    self.UI.setAttribute("score_player2_value", "text", TRH['score_p2v'] or "-")
end

function onSave()
    local component = self.getComponent("MeshCollider") or self.getComponent("BoxCollider")
    local data = {col = component.get("enabled")}
    return JSON.encode(data)
end

function onLoad(save)
    local data = JSON.decode(save) or { col = true }
    component = self.getComponent("MeshCollider") or self.getComponent("BoxCollider")
    component.set("enabled", data.col)
    self.interactable = data.col
    rebuildUI()
    Wait.frames(refresh, 2)
    if (adconfig.INITIALDISPLAY == "sequence") then
        Wait.frames(displaySequence, 3)
    else
        Wait.frames(displayRandom, 3)
    end
end

    ["display"] = {
        desc = "Change the order in which the ads are displayed",
        arguments = {
            {"sequence|random", "one after another or randomly determined", true}
        },
        requiredArgs = 1,
        call = function(player, display)
            if (display == "sequence") then displaySequence() end
            if (display == "random") then displayRandom() end
            --Wait.frames(refresh, 2)
            return cmdconst.OK
        end
    },
    ["mode"] = {
        desc = "toggles between game mode (disabled collisions and non-interactive) and edit mode",
        arguments = {

        call = function(player, mode)
            if (mode == "game") then
                self.interactable = false
                (self.getComponent("MeshCollider") or self.getComponent("BoxCollider")).set("enabled", false)
            elseif (mode == "edit") then
                self.interactable = true
                (self.getComponent("MeshCollider") or self.getComponent("BoxCollider")).set("enabled", true)
            end
            return cmdconst.OK
        end
    }
}

local LOBO_MISSION_LINES=JSON.decode("[{\"points\":[[12,1.1811267280578601,-24],[12,1.1811267280578601,24]],\"color\":[0.9,0.55,0.1],\"thickness\":0.045},{\"points\":[[-12,1.1811267280578601,-24],[-12,1.1811267280578601,24]],\"color\":[0.9,0.55,0.1],\"thickness\":0.045}]")
local loboSurfaceOnLoad=onLoad
function onLoad(saved)
 if loboSurfaceOnLoad then loboSurfaceOnLoad(saved) end
 Wait.frames(function()
  local localLines={}
  local scale=self.getScale()
  local lineScale=math.max(math.abs(scale.x),math.abs(scale.z),0.000001)
  for _,line in ipairs(LOBO_MISSION_LINES) do
   local points={}
   for _,point in ipairs(line.points) do
    local p=self.positionToLocal(point)
    points[#points+1]={p.x,p.y,p.z}
   end
   localLines[#localLines+1]={points=points,color=line.color,thickness=line.thickness/lineScale}
  end
  self.setVectorLines(localLines)
 end,2)
end
